coverage.summary: Applies to all rental properties used for dwelling purposes, including mobile homes, except owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings.
coverage.owner_conditions: Owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings are exempt.

result.notes: Coverage is supported by the DCA Truth in Renting guide (D067), which is a secondary summary of N.J.S.A. 2A:42-10.10. The existing values are correct. requires_unknown_facts is set to false because the rule covers ordinary residential rentals, and the owner-occupied 2-3 family exemption is captured in owner_conditions. None of the other documents (D065, D066, D068, D069, DX16) address the reprisal statute.
